CAP. 254] Industrial Designs
4
CHAPTER 254
11 of 2001. INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS ACT (COMMENCEMENT) ORDER
Act 13 of 2000.
(Section 32)
[3rd February, 2001]
Short title. 1. This Order may be cited as the
INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS ACT (COMMENCEMENT)
ORDER.
Commencement 2. In exercise of the powers vested in me by section 32 of the
of Chapter 254.
Industrial Designs Act and all other powers thereunto me enabling,
I,GODFREY SMITH, Minister responsible for Industrial Designs,
do hereby appoint the 5th day of January, 2001, as the day on
which the said Act shall come into force.
MADE this 4th day of January, 2001.
(GODFREY SMITH)
Minister responsible for Industrial Designs
